subject: Two-wave webinar: slot split + bridge details
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Liu <sophie@fastretail.com>, engops@fastretail.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Two-wave webinar: proposed slots and agenda

Hi Sophie and team,

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood Inference — excited to run a short group demo tailored to your engineers and product leads. To make timing easier across regions, were proposing a two-wave session on Tuesday, Nov 2: a morning wave (US) and an early evening wave (APAC-friendly). This lets engineering folks attend the technical deep-dive while product can join the overview.

Proposed slots (pick one wave):
- Wave A (US-friendly): Nov 2, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wave B (APAC-friendly): Nov 2, 18:00–19:00 PT (works for EMEA/APAC)

Agenda (attached): brief intro (10m), live demo (25m), Q&A + integration patterns (20m), next steps (5m).

Can you confirm which wave your team prefers? If you have specific folks who need dedicated time (security, infra, procurement), flag them and well loop them into a short pre-demo sync.

Ive attached a one-pager agenda and will follow up with a bridge invite once we lock the slot.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: agenda-two-wave.pdf
From: Sophie Liu <sophie@fastretail.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: engops@fastretail.com
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2027 17:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Two-wave webinar: proposed slots and agenda

Thanks Ava — appreciate the flexible approach.

Wave A (10am PT) works best for our PMs and SRE leads, but our payments team is on APAC hours and would prefer Wave B. Could we do this as a single joint session with a short break after the demo so the payments folks can join for the integration Q&A? If that makes the session too long for your team, wed prefer Wave B specifically for payments (they can dial in only for the last 30 minutes).

Also, can you share a calendar invite that is timezone-aware so our folks in APAC see the correct wall time?

Best,
Sophie
Head of Product Integration | FastRetail

Subject: Re: Two-wave webinar: proposed slots and agenda (internal plan)

Ava — quick internal note while Sophie decides:

If they want both waves but with overlapping coverage, I recommend we run a single 75-minute session split into two blocks: 35m demo + 10m break + 25–30m integration Q&A. Ben can host the demo and handle core infra questions; Ill stay on for the Q&A and run a short 1:1 with payments afterwards if needed. That reduces churn for their attendees and keeps the bridge/recording simple.

Logistics checklist:
- Send timezone-aware calendar invite (use ICS that includes both wave times).
- Bridge: use our multi-region Zoom link; set recording to cloud and auto-upload to shared drive.
- Roles CSV for panel: who speaks when (Ill attach).
- Add engops@fastretail.com to the calendar so SREs get the right timezone info.

I attached a quick 'roles' CSV (internal) and can stub the bridge invite once Sophie confirms.

— Karthik

Subject: Confirmed: Nov 2 two-wave plan + bridge details

Hi Sophie — thanks for the quick reply and helpful note.

We can absolutely do a single split session that covers both groups. Final plan below:

Nov 2 — joint session (split)
- 10:00–10:35 PT: Intro + live demo (recording ON)
- 10:35–10:45 PT: short break / recap for APAC attendees to join
- 10:45–11:15 PT: Integration Q&A (payments breakouts as needed)

Bridge & invites
- Zoom bridge (multi-region): https://zoom.redwood.com/j/987654321 (passcode in invite)
- Calendar invite attached (.ics) — should show correct local times for all recipients.

Action items for FastRetail
- Confirm list of attendees who need breakout follow-ups (payments, security) and a single contact for procurement redlines.
- Add engops@fastretail.com to the invite so SREs see the event in their calendars.

Internal: Ben will present the demo; Karthik will lead integration Q&A. Ill send the calendar invite and upload the recording afterward.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
